_comment: Act 1 script: objectives, radio lines, tutorial hints and cinematic subtitles for the Dead City. Speakers: Kael, Oren (radio), Lyra (transmission). 'at' is seconds from the start of a cinematic; 'seconds' is how long a line stays up.

objectives.reach_main: Cross the district toward the broadcast tower
objectives.find_way: Find a way past the collapsed overpass
objectives.restore_power: Restore power to the tower: find fuses (%d / 2)
objectives.junction: Reroute the junction panel in the tower
objectives.transmit: Triangulate the signal at the transmitter console
objectives.done: Leave the city by East Avenue when you are ready (south end)

side_objectives.pharmacy: Optional: start the pharmacy's backup generator

hints.move: WASD to move  ·  Mouse to look  ·  Shift to sprint
hints.mantle: Yellow edges can be climbed: face one and press Space
hints.ladder: E to climb down the ladder
hints.crouch: C to crouch. Crouched, Kael is quiet and harder to see
hints.takedown: Approach from behind while unseen and press E for a silent takedown
hints.bottle: G throws a bottle. The Hollows go to the noise
hints.combat: LMB light attack  ·  RMB heavy  ·  Q block, tap just before a hit to parry  ·  F dodge
hints.rain: Rain covers your footsteps. The Hollows hear less in it
hints.axe: The Fire Axe breaks armour. Press 2 to equip it
hints.bulwark: Armoured. Light blows glance off: use heavy attacks or the axe

street.speaker: Oren
street.text: Street level. Keep low, son. The quiet ones in the road are Hollows. They'll go to a sound before they go to a shape.

street.speaker: Oren
street.text: 'Course you do. Humour an old man. Tower's north. Tall thing, can't miss it.

main_street.speaker: Oren
main_street.text: That's the old overpass come down across Central. You won't climb that.

main_street.speaker: Oren
main_street.text: There's a metro station on your side of the street. Line runs straight under the block. Wouldn't call it safe. Would call it a way through.

metro.speaker: Oren
metro.text: You're breaking up. Lot of concrete over your head. If you hear clicking, that's not the pipes.

plaza.speaker: Oren
plaza.text: There she is. Forty years of the nine o'clock news came off that mast.

plaza.speaker: Oren
plaza.text: Junction panel's in the base. It'll want two fuses. One's in the metro hall you just came through, east wall under the red lamp. Other's in the Learning Centre, across the plaza.

first_fuse.speaker: Oren
first_fuse.text: That's one. Panel takes two. Look for the orange glow.

fuses_done.speaker: Oren
fuses_done.text: That's both. Seat them in the panel and wake her up.

power_on.speaker: Oren
power_on.text: She's humming! Kael, that mast is the loudest thing in the city right now. Everything that can hear is coming.

wave_clear.speaker: Oren
wave_clear.text: It's gone quiet. Get to the console before it stops being quiet.

pharmacy_power.speaker: Oren
pharmacy_power.text: Was that a generator? Whatever's behind that shutter, I hope it's worth the company.

journal_done.speaker: Kael
journal_done.text: "She is still knocking." ...Thank you, Mara. Wherever you got to.

prologue.speaker: Lyra
prologue.text: Kael... if you can hear this, I'm still here.

prologue.speaker: Lyra
prologue.text: Come to Meridian. Don't let it finish the song.

prologue.speaker: Oren
prologue.text: Whoever's on this frequency, you heard that too. Tell me you heard that.

prologue.speaker: Oren
prologue.text: Name's Oren. I've been listening to nothing for twenty years, and tonight nothing said a name. The old broadcast tower could pin where it's coming from.

ending.speaker: Kael
ending.text: Console's alive. Bearing... north-east. Forty kilometres.

ending.speaker: Oren
ending.text: Meridian. That's the Resonance Institute, out under the forest. They sealed that place from the outside, Kael.

ending.speaker: Oren
ending.text: You'll want the service tunnel on the east side. Main doors won't have opened since the night it happened.

ending.speaker: Kael
ending.text: ...How do you know which doors opened?

ending.speaker: Oren
ending.text: Old maps. I've had a long time to read. Get moving, son. Dawn's coming.

prologue: Follow the marker across the rooftops.
Run and press Space to jump the gap to the next roof, climb onto the yellow edge with Space, then go to the ladder at the roof's south edge and press E to climb down.
reach_main: Head north toward the broadcast tower: the tall mast you can see over the rooftops.
Follow the marker north to Main Street. Crouch (C) past the Hollows, or throw a bottle (G) to pull them away from your path.
find_way: The overpass blocks the avenue. Look for another way under it.
Use the metro: the stairs going down into the station are on Main Street, near the marker. The tunnel takes you north under the block.
reach_tower: Keep going north through the metro.
Follow the metro tunnel north to the far stairs and climb up into Tower Plaza. The tower is the tall mast in the middle.
restore_power: Fuses glow orange, with a column of light above them. The marker points to the nearest one you haven't taken.

One fuse is in the metro hall, on the east side under a dim red lamp. The other is in the Learning Centre on the plaza, on a crate in the back-right corner as you come in (the west end). Then take both to the junction panel in the base of the tower.
junction: The junction panel is inside the base of the tower.
Press E at the panel. Each breaker flips its own relay and its neighbours. Close every relay: try the breakers one at a time and watch which lights change.
defend: Kill everything that came onto the plaza.
Six enemies: kill the Spitter first, keep a wall behind you, dodge (F) the Skitters' dash, and use an injector (H) when there's a gap.
transmit: The transmitter console is in the base of the tower.
Go back into the base of the tower and press E at the transmitter console.
done: The road out of the city is at the south end of East Avenue.
Follow the marker to the south end of East Avenue and press E to leave for Meridian.
